question: Which complete downstream module writes mediate the dominant residual bypass of the construction-specific upstream oracle intervention?

prior_art.known_lessons: A responsive module is not a mediator; native module boundaries are proposals; greedy union requires measured singleton composition; the whole attention-15 branch is too small to license factor splitting.
prior_art.novelty: Cross the fixed upstream oracle with the source of every complete attention/MLP write in layers 12-17 and their joint write bank, preserving the carried residual background.

frozen_design.evaluation: Opposite-parity fixed oracle projectors; v15 A1/A2/P/C only; no refit, gain, or outcome-selected module.
frozen_design.joint_mediator: all twelve complete module writes installed together
frozen_design.accounting: Rowwise margin rescue, reset loss, bypass, and Mobius interaction; cellwise P/C KL and flips. Test joint bank before interpreting singleton rankings.
frozen_design.composition: Compare sum of twelve singleton reset-loss vectors with joint-bank reset loss. Greedy module union is licensed only when cosine >=.90 and relative L2 <=.25 in every own-target expert/parity cell.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_closure_finitene: All hashes, native/self replays, row coverage, factorial closures, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_joint_suffix_write_bank_mediates_: Joint-bank reset loss and rescue each project >=.50 onto the full upstream effect with direction fraction >=.875 in every expert/parity own target.
predictions.pred_c_stable_singleton_module_mediator_: At least one identical singleton module has positive reset-loss projection >=.10 and direction fraction >=.75 in every expert/parity own target.
predictions.pred_d_singleton_module_effects_compose: The sum of singleton reset losses predicts joint-bank reset loss with cosine >=.90 and relative L2 <=.25 in every expert/parity own target.
predictions.pred_e_selected_module_mediation_is_cont: Every module satisfying C adds zero P/C flips and changed-versus-background mean KL <=.02 in reset and rescue cells.

decision: A failure invalidates. B failure identifies direct residual carry beyond downstream writes. B/C with D licenses parity-cross-fit greedy module union; B/C without D licenses interaction-aware module sets. B without C diagnoses distributed write mediation. E gates selective promotion.
